# ClaudeMC v1.19.0

## ClaudeMC Companion — browser-based companion app

An embedded HTTP server (`com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer`) starts automatically at mod init and serves a single-page companion app at **`http://localhost:8080`**. A `[ClaudeMC]` button is injected into the top-right corner of the Minecraft title screen via `TitleScreenMixin`; clicking it opens the app in the default browser.

### Scanner tab
- **MCScans** — queries `api.mcscans.fi/public/v1/servers` with software/auth-mode/max-results filters; each result cross-referenced against VulnDb with colour-coded CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / PATCHED badges.
- **Shodan search** — free-text query sent to the Shodan API; results enriched with VulnDb data. Requires Shodan API key in Settings.
- **Enrich** — per-row action that concurrently queries mcsrvstat.us and mcstatus.io (12 s timeout each) and expands the row with MOTD, plugin list, and player count.
- **Analyze** — per-row AI exploit analysis; sends server fingerprint to the AI and returns a ranked plan with verbatim commands.
- Status bar: "X servers found — Y vulnerable".

### Chat tab
- Full AI conversation with scrollable history, user/AI bubbles, basic markdown rendering, Enter-to-send, and 6-turn context window.
- Custom system prompt: "You are ClaudeMC Companion, an assistant for Minecraft exploit research."

### Settings tab
- All fields from `AIConfig` editable in the browser: provider, Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini keys, Shodan API key (new in this release), model, max tokens, system prompt.
- Saved immediately to `config/claudemc/ai.json` on Submit.

### Alts tab
- Current account banner with Restore button.
- Per-alt Switch and Delete actions.
- Add Offline Alt and Add Session Alt (username + UUID + access token) forms.

### VulnDb tab
- Full vulnerability database loaded once; client-side search and severity filter.

## New: `shodanApiKey` field in AIConfig

`config/claudemc/ai.json` now persists a `shodanApiKey` field used by the companion's Shodan search. Set it in the companion Settings tab — no file editing required.

## Technical details

- Server binds to `127.0.0.1`; tries ports 8080 → 8081 → 8082 → 8083 → 8084 in order.
- All request handlers run on `Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()`.
- mcsrvstat.us requests include `User-Agent: ClaudeMC-Companion/1.19` (required by the API).
- `TitleScreenMixin` uses `@Shadow` to access the protected `addDrawableChild` from `Screen`.
